newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel Venezuelan unit issues synthetic notes.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel Venezuelan unit issues synthetic notes.

text.p: J.P. Morgan said on Monday that it had arranged an $80 million private placement of synthetic notes for a Venezuelan subsidiary of Japan's Kobe Steel Ltd.

The transaction for Operaciones al Sur del Orinoco C.A., 99.9 percent owned by Kobe Steel, was the first of its kind combining a traditional export receivables-backed transaction with a total return swap, J.P. Morgan said in a statement.
The introduction of a total return swap, a form of a credit derivative, would minimise the investment risks inherent in the Venezuelan component of the transaction, it said.
